name: Quy Nhon beach
kicker: The yellow crescent in the center of the city
summary: Yellow-sand crescent in the city center: swim it free for an hour or a full day, a short walk from the rooms. The shore is a long curve of yellow sand, and the water stays fairly clear and blue. Use the morning for the swim. Open hours run from 6:00 to 23:00.
timeNeeded: About an hour. A beach day is longer.
getThere: A walk from the center if you sleep on the crescent.
heroCaption: The crescent from the hill: sand, surf, and the roofs along the beach

notice.title: Kỳ Co is a separate cove
notice.body: This swim is the yellow crescent in the center. Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km away, in xã Nhơn Lý.

body: Walk a few steps from the center and swim the long crescent. The sand is yellow, and the water along this shore stays fairly clear and blue. The listed visit is an hour. A beach day runs longer than that hour, from a morning swim through the late light on the same sand.

The promenade follows the sand, with the hills behind the roofs. A chair or an umbrella is a separate hire. Victory square sits on this shore, between đường 31 Tháng 3 and Nguyễn Huệ to the north and Xuân Diệu and the sea to the south, so the square is part of the same walk.

figures.caption: The promenade along the crescent at the end of the day
figures.alt: People walking the promenade beside the yellow sand of Quy Nhon beach at dusk

gettingThere: The beach is in the center, in Phường Quy Nhơn. Sleep on the crescent and the sand is a walk from the rooms. Open hours run from 6:00 to 23:00.

legs.heading: From the crescent
legs.body: Walk. The sand starts at the end of the beach streets.

closed: No weekly closing day is listed.
admissionNote: Free. A chair or an umbrella is Check on arrival.
